name: kcmps-mail-lambdas
description: Dependencies for backend/mail/*.js (SES relay inbound-mail ingest + staff mail read API, docs/roadmap.md 'Parallel track — Staff email panel', SES relay track). Deploy each handler .js as its own Lambda; mail-parse.js is a shared module zipped alongside, plus ../lib on the module path. ingest-inbound.js is the only handler that needs mailparser — the repo has no root package.json/build step, so this Lambda's zip must be built with `npm install` run in THIS directory first (see backend/infra/README.md's SES relay staging section), vendoring mailparser + its transitive deps into node_modules/. The read-path Lambdas (get-mailboxes/get-mail-messages/get-mail-message/mark-mail-read) and send-reply.js don't use mailparser directly (send-reply.js needs @aws-sdk/client-ses instead) but share this package.json/zip build for simplicity — a leaner split can happen later if cold-start size becomes a problem.
